reuse.why: Calls the shared assertNotLinkedElsewhere, link.findOrCreateBank, bankSync.syncAccount and handleSyncResponse, but the link body and the transaction download are cloned from the Akahu/Pluggy implementations instead of factored out.

duplication.why: linkFintegraAccount is a near line-for-line copy of linkAkahuAccount (upgrade-or-insert account, payee, sync, sync-event), and downloadFintegraTransactions copies the Pluggy/Akahu download/error/response mapping.

placement.why: Each piece lands where its siblings live: link handler and registration in accounts/app.ts, download and dispatch in accounts/sync.ts, base URL in server-config.ts, type in types/models.

scope.why: Only the Fintegra provider plumbing is added; no unrelated edits.

maintainability.why: Consistent with the tree's per-provider pattern, so easy to follow, but adds a sixth copy of the link flow that any future fix must repeat.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Uses the existing guard, bank lookup and sync helpers; the tree has no shared provider-link function to bypass.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied link and download blocks keep the original shape and names, only the provider string changes.
